facts.fact: IANOR's draft 2026 national standardisation programme lists ISO/IEC 14651:2025 (information technology, string comparison and collation) as a revision of existing national standard NA 13037, proposed by CNIG; the document gives the programme's publication date, 2026-02-01, as its only date.

note: Draft programme; the other entries read (library statistics, records management, sampling) are not IT or data standards in the passages seen, and no certification is stated.
